results.title: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Inventory Issues and approximately 18% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
results.description: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC (“KSF”) and KSF partner, former Attorney General of Louisiana, Charles C. Foti, Jr., remind investors with substantial losses that they have until September 22, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation ("Procept" or the "Company") (NasdaqGM: PRCT), if they purchased the Company’s shares between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026, inclusive (the “Class Period”). This action is pending
